item.title: Iran war success gives president a Trump card to play in China meeting
item.summary: President Donald Trump's March summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing should emphasize Iran war leverage over traditional trade issues.

item.title: Trump warns NATO of 'very bad' future if allies don't help secure Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: President Donald Trump warned NATO allies who fail to help defend the Strait of Hormuz, escalating tensions over military burden-sharing responsibilities.

item.title: Arizona man who admitted to crucifying pastor asks for death penalty so 'we can move on with our lives'
item.summary: An Arizona man accused of crucifying a pastor requested the death penalty, saying he wants the case to end quickly and has never claimed to be innocent.

item.title: Dem candidate's unearthed 'winter Texan' comment could haunt campaign
item.summary: Bobby Pulido is facing scrutiny over the amount of time he spends in Mexico as the Latin Grammy winner pursues Texas' 15th Congressional District seat against Rep. Monica De La Cruz.

item.title: Martha Stewart's cardiologist says a simple smoothie add-in is like 'taking Ozempic'
item.summary: Martha Stewart says her cardiologist compared beetroot powder to "taking Ozempic" for weight loss. She now adds the supplement daily to her green juice.

item.title: Controversial strike three gives Team USA win at World Baseball Classic, social media erupts
item.summary: A controversial strike three call ended the Dominican Republic's hopes of making it to the World Baseball Classic final and allowed Team USA to advance.

item.title: Patient in Canada waits over 12 hours in hospital emergency room: 'I'd rather pay’
item.summary: After severe abdominal pain sent her to the ER, a Canadian woman faced a 15-hour wait, as physicians warn of worsening overcrowding and staffing shortages nationwide.

item.title: Chinese spy tech is endangering US hospitals. Texas is trying to shut that down
item.summary: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott leads fight against Chinese medical devices after Food and Drug Administration warns of backdoors in hospital equipment.

item.title: Aaron Judge calls World Baseball Classic atmosphere 'bigger and better than the World Series'
item.summary: Team USA slugger Aaron Judge said Sunday night after their win that the World Baseball Classic's atmosphere is "bigger and better than the World Series."
